advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the power to do anything we want. Absolute control over every single particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that has ever existed and everything that ever will. From now on, are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you're not, I can make you listen, for I can do anything. From this moment on, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, for I possess the Key of Time!
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: Apart from Rassilon himself, no Time Lord President has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Key of Time, your power does not end here. You will not be troubled by such a trivial thing as death. The Sixfold God is still watching over you
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: A crystal with possibly countless origins. Rassilon possessed it, or perhaps its maker. Now, you have obtained it, and the universe will bow to you
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: A golden pocket watch... It possesses a portion of the Time Key's power, capable of reversing the player's death...
message.doctor_m.time_key.neutral_tip: §7Sneak + Right Click to enable Forced Neutral Mode
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dThe fragment's power has prevented death from occurring..
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §cThe fragment cannot protect you forever. You must wait for it to recover. Time remaining: %s
